items.caption: The seal-script form of 歲 is analyzed as 步 with 戌 serving as a phonetic element. This later account does not resolve competing explanations of the early graph.
items.alt: Black seal-script rendering of 歲, with a compact upper section above a larger, complex lower section.
items.selection_reason: It shows the seal-script form tied to the transmitted analysis, helping distinguish that account from disputed explanations of earlier forms.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector rendering, not an image of an ancient artifact. Early forms have competing explanations, and the available accounts do not establish one original formation or a continuous path from early uses to later senses.
